newsitem.title: USA: Dauphin says in talks with another company.
newsitem.headline: Dauphin says in talks with another company.

text.p: Dauphin Deposit Corp said it is currently in discussions which may lead to its acquisition by another financial services company.
Fran Minakowski, a spokeswoman for the Harrisburg, Pa.,-based bank holding company, declined to provide further information.

Dauphin Deposit, with assets of $5.9 billion, is parent of Dauphin Deposit Bank and Trust Co, which includeds the Bank of Pennsylvania, Farmers Bank and Valleybank divisions and Eastern Mortgage Services Inc, according to the announcement.
The bank operates about 100 branch offices in 12 Pennsylvania counties and is also parent to Hopper Soliday & Co Inc, an investment banking firm, the announcement said.
